issue_gist: HarmonicFitter.ParameterGuesser (commons-math MATH-844) can compute an unusable amplitude guess (and thus bad a/omega/phase) because its guessing algorithm is fragile on some data, e.g. noisy or sparse samples, or data where the integration-based estimate breaks down. This can lead to NaN or nonsensical values or a MathIllegalStateException.

validation.why_invalid: some inputs inside buggyIf fail on the developer fix
